prompt: Nora fixes the streetlamp before dark
title: Streetlamp Glow
irony: Nora hurries to fix the lamp before dark, yet the lamp only shines when dark comes.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Teddy and Benny watch the gray streetlamp flicker at dusk on the quiet street.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy recites lamp facts on the street while Benny begs to play tag before dark.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Knox kicks a toy into the lamp and the light goes out as dusk deepens.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Teddy, Benny, Knox and Nora chant round the dark lamp on the street.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Lou lends a wobbly ladder at the diner while Teddy corrects Nora and the rung shakes.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Knox dares Teddy up the ladder while soup splashes Lou's clean shoes.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The friends chant at the diner window facing the dark lamp as stars pop out.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Nora holds the cold lamp post beside Lou and feels the dusk chill bite.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Nora chooses a warm hug first and lifts Benny to the switch.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Nora sings the turned line as light floods the street and kids cheer.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The friends hum under the streetlamp glow while moths dance in the warm light.
